div.head: I Cn 7
div.ab: And we lærað ⁊ biddað on Godes naman beodað, þæt ænig Cristen mann binnon VI manna sibfæce on his agenum cynne æfre ne gewifie, ne on mæges lafe þe swa neahsib wære, ne on þæs wifes nedmagon þe he sylf ær hæfde;

And we instruct and pray and enjoin, in the name of God, that no Christian man shall ever marry among his own kin within six degrees of relationship, or with the widow of a man as nearly related to him as that, or with a near relative of his first wife's.
